components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: Optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner has the same lastName and address (a shared household). Request-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned code 'LAST3-NNNN' — the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners with the same lastName and address (a shared household).
              type: string
              example: 'H-1a2b3c'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george@example.com|H-1a2b3c'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Server-derived code '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level assigned on creation: starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Canonical region derived from city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "Derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

              description: "True once more than 80 owners have already been created today, otherwise false."

              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

## Summary

I implemented soft-duplicate detection for `POST /api/owners`: when a new owner isn't a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's `lastName` and `postcode` with a different telephone, it's still created and the response now reports `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id (otherwise `possibleDuplicate: false`).

Following the project's OfficeFloor conventions (one small cohesive function class per step), the change is spread across small units rather than growing any existing function:

- **`DetectPossibleDuplicate.java`** (new) — a single small step that, given the built `@Val Owner` and the repository, records the matching existing owner's id via `owner.setPossibleDuplicateOf(...)`. Mirrors the existing `CountNamesakes`/`RequireUniqueHousehold` pattern.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new step between `namesakes` and `save`, under the same `transaction` governance.
- **`Owner.java`** — one persisted field `possibleDuplicateOf` (`Integer`) plus its getter/setter; the boolean `possibleDuplicate` is derived, not stored.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — one added `@Mapping` expression deriving `possibleDuplicate` as `getPossibleDuplicateOf() != null`; `possibleDuplicateOf` auto-maps by name.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the two read-only fields to the `Owner` schema so the generated DTO exposes them.
- **`db/hsqldb/schema.sql`** + **`data.sql`** — added the `possible_duplicate_of` column (appended last to keep positional seed inserts aligned; I only touched the hsqldb schema, matching how `namesake_count`/`postcode` were previously maintained).

Design choices that kept structural impact low: I persisted a single nullable `Integer` (deriving the boolean in the mapper) rather than two columns/accessors, and I added a new tiny step instead of enlarging `CountNamesakes` — so every changed function stays at CC ~1–3 with minimal surrounding complexity. The new `AcceptanceTest.coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` and the full suite pass (BUILD SUCCESS).
